title: fix(plugin-detail): empty related lists fold into one line; record:path terminal stages share the rail
body:
Fixes #25895

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
改了什么：记录页「相关」页签里没有记录的相关列表不再各占一整行，而是在有记录的列表之后合成一行，列出它们的名字，每个保留「新建」；阶段条（record:path）上的终止阶段（已取消 / 客户未到、成交 / 失败）与其它阶段等宽分配，标签换行而不是挤成一格。
为什么改：HotCRM 客户页「客户 0 · 暂无相关记录」夹在有数据的列表之间；活动页的「× 已取消 客户未到」挤在右端一个窄格里（#25895 两张截图）。
风险与回滚：只改显示，不加不删任何元数据键；全空的栈、单个列表、带「添加」选择器或工具栏动作的列表保持原样；有新记录时折叠的列表自动回到原位。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
先看：`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedListEmptyFold.tsx`（规则与折叠行）→ `renderers/record-related-list.tsx`（接入）→ `renderers/record-path.tsx`（等分宽度）。
两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-related-list.emptyFold-25895.test.tsx packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-path.terminalWidth-25895.test.tsx`，预期 12 个测试全过。
需要你做的：无，绿了即可落地；新文案的语言包键是后续工作（见下文）。

## What

**Item 1 — empty related lists fold into one line.** On a record's Related tab, the lists with zero records leave their place once every list of the stack has answered, and the last list of the stack draws one line after itself: the empty-state text, then each folded list's title with its own **New** (same handler, same `createDisabled` verdict). A folded list stays mounted (hidden), so when it gains a record it answers "not empty" and returns to its place. Unchanged by design: a stack whose lists are all empty, a list on its own, and an empty list that offers more than New (an `add` picker, child toolbar actions, an authoring notice) draw exactly as before.

**Item 2 — terminal stages get legible width.** On the desktop rail both stage groups now start from zero and grow by the number of stages they hold, and every stage fills its share, so a terminal stage is exactly as wide as any other. A terminal stage's label (the won terminus and the separated lost group) wraps instead of being truncated or held on one line. Ordinary forward stages keep their one truncated line; the mobile row (horizontal scroll) is unchanged.

## Which seam, and why (item 1)

Who stacks the lists: `buildDefaultTabs` (`synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`) only emits the Related tab's `record:related_list` children; `page:tabs` (`PageTabsRenderer` in `@object-ui/components`) draws them as plain siblings through `renderChildren`; `RecordDetailView` only hands `related` to the synthesizer. None of the three knows how many rows a list has — each list learns that from its own read — and an authored page can stack lists in any container.

So the seam is the block itself: `record:related_list` lists that share a DOM container coordinate through a small store keyed by that container (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedListEmptyFold.tsx`). `RelatedList` gains one optional callback, `onEmptyChange(empty)`, reporting its settled answer (`null` while a read is in flight); the block keeps the last answer during a refetch so a write elsewhere does not unfold and refold the stack. This reaches synthesized and authored pages alike, adds no node type and no spec key, and leaves the synthesizer, app-shell and components untouched.

`RelatedList.tsx` and the new `RelatedListEmptyFold.tsx` are outside the claim's listed file surface (one optional prop plus one effect, and the new module); both sit in the same package beside the claimed files.

## Strings and locale packs

No new translation key is introduced. The fold line reuses `detail.noRelatedRecords` and `detail.new`, both already in every pack; each folded entry is a `role="group"` named by the list's title, so each **New** is announced inside its list's name. A dedicated phrase such as 「其他 2 个为空：客户、线索」 needs a new key in the locale packs, which this PR does not touch (that line is busy); it is a follow-up once the i18n line drains. Note for that follow-up: `check:i18n-keys` refuses a `t()` key absent from the `en` pack and its baseline is empty, so an inline `defaultValue` alone would not pass CI — the key has to land in the packs.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-related-list.emptyFold-25895.test.tsx` (6 tests) and `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-path.terminalWidth-25895.test.tsx` (6 tests), committed red first (`aba3b5ca`).
- Red leg, implementation files restored to the base `f02e6443` in the tree (markers `onEmptyChange` / `shareOf` counted 0): 9 failed / 3 passed — the three that pass are CONTROL legs that hold before and after (all-empty stack, single list, ordinary forward stage). Restore proven by blob hashes equal to HEAD. Green leg: 12/12.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail --maxWorkers=2` (from `ui/`, at `5cf6e03e`): 306 files passed, 1 failed — `spec-symbol-batch7.test.ts` names every props type in `renderers/` that is not spelled `…RendererProps`; the fold module was moved out of `renderers/` to `src/` (beside `EmptySectionsFold.tsx`) in `47121545`, and the post-merge run below covers that file.
- Consumers of the changed rendering, run as a targeted set (not the full app-shell suite): 34 files that mention an empty related list or `record:related_list` under `app-shell`, `apps/console` and `components`, plus the `RecordDetailView` related-list files: 34/34 files, 293/293 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check`: exit 0.
- `sdui.manifest.json`: regenerated under the lock before the merge, byte-unchanged (106 components, sha256 `1f6e1ccb925a…`); no record is committed (the sources records were retired on `main`). `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0.

After merging `origin/main` (merge `8271adf9`, which retired `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/`; no plugin-detail or lockfile overlap), at head `8271adf9`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` (main moved spec), then `spec-symbol-batch7.test.ts` plus every `record-path*`, `record-related-list*`, `recordComponentAria*` and `RelatedList*` test in plugin-detail: 59/59 files, 396/396 tests. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 35 derived families, all run, each exit 0 (`check-sdui-manifest.mjs` among them); `--ran` reconciled 35/35 with exit codes recorded, 0 NOT-MEASURED.

## Acceptance notes

- A related list whose read FAILS shows today's empty state ("No related records found") because `RelatedList` only logs the error; with this change such a list is also folded as empty. That is unchanged behaviour of the read path, noted, not filed here.
- The stack is the DOM container: lists an authored page wraps in separate containers never fold together, by design.
- The terminal-stage share is equal up to the alt group's divider gap and padding.
